source.text:
Von oben sieht man's am besten: Pizza, Pasta, Caprese – drei Klassiker, ein Tisch. 🍕🍝🍅 Unser Tipp für den Donnerstagabend: zu dritt kommen, alles bestellen, alles teilen. Swipe für den zweiten Blick. ➡️

#pastaia #spandau #berlinspandau #pizzaberlin #pastaberlin #caprese #zumteilen #italienischessen #foodberlin #buonappetito

claims.text: the post is about Thursday evening
claims.subject: none

reference.notes: The venue is named only by the hashtag #pastaia next to #spandau, and the 'Unser Tipp' voice marks it as the venue's own promotional post, so Pastaia in Spandau is taken as the place. 'Von oben sieht man's am besten' and 'Swipe' are narration about the photos and are left out.

match.note: The author account spells the name 'Pastaia' in Spandau, and no candidate has that name. Pizza Pasta Gatow is in Spandau but has a different name.

claims.text: Pastaia serves Pizza, Pasta and Caprese, three classics on one table
